comment: Kodak VISION Color Print Film 2383 'Sensitometric Curves' (F002_1254AC), p.4. Raster image (about 150 dpi native), read by eye: every 0.1 log E. Exposure 1/500 s tungsten + heat-absorbing glass; Process ECP-2D; Status A densitometry. Axis calibration from the drawn ticks on the 400 dpi render (clip aligned to whole pixels): log E -3.0 at pixel 186.5 and 3.0 at 1211 (x), density 0.0 at pixel 1174 and 6.0 at 147.5 (y), converted to PDF points as (clip origin px + pixel) * 72/400. In the toe the G and R lines overlap into one band from log E -0.7 to 0.0; G was read from the band's top edge and R from its bottom edge (both within 0.02 D). B and G merge into the shoulder plateau near log E 1.9-2.0; R continues alone to about 2.58.
